subject: Vendor onboarding: payment ramp & early-remit options
messages:
From: Katie Ramirez <katie@lumenline.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenline.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: payment ramp & early-remit options

Hi Lauren / Aditya,

Thanks for the quick intro — I’m Katie on the finance side at LumenLine. We’re excited to get set up in Redwood for the next quarter. I attached our standard onboarding package (W9 + onboarding form) so Procurement / AP can validate.

Quick background: our standard customer terms are Net45. We can offer an early-pay discount structure (tiered) if shortened remittance is an option:
- Net15 = 2.0% discount
- Net30 = 1.0% discount

If Redwood prefers Net30 we can accept that; otherwise we’d like to understand whether Redwood’s PO flow requires invoice-only submission or whether you can split setup vs monthly SaaS invoices.

Attachments: LumenLine_W9.pdf, LL_onboarding_form.xlsx

Primary questions for your team:
1) Do you need vendor banking details in the vendor portal or via secure DocuSign?
2) Is Redwood able to commit to a PO number up front so we can route invoices?
3) Any preference on early-pay rates / rounding?

Happy to hop on 20–30 minute call this week if that helps speed onboarding.

Thanks —
Katie Ramirez
Finance Manager, LumenLine Solutions
katie@lumenline.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: lauren.bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Katie Ramirez <katie@lumenline.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment ramp & early-remit options

Hi Katie — thanks for sending this over, and welcome. I’m Lauren (vendor ops / partnerships) — looping in Aditya (Procurement) and Monica (Accounts Payable) who will own the PO and bank/ACH setup.

High-level from Redwood: for most platform vendors we default to Net30. For larger enterprise arrangements we will consider Net45 or a short ramp (Net45 then Net30 after X months) depending on contract and risk profile. A couple of practical notes:
- Redwood requires a PO before we process monthly invoices (we can generate PO-IDs once vendor is approved in the portal).
- AP prefers ACH for recurring payments; we do accept wire for initial onboarding fees if needed.
- We can split invoices (one-time setup/implementation + recurring usage) — that usually speeds payment on the setup fee.

Proposed action plan:
1) Aditya to confirm procurement path + any special approvals for Net45 (timeline: 48–72 hours).
2) Monica to request final W9 and ACH form via secure DocuSign (I attached a VendorOnboardChecklist you can use to confirm items).
3) Once vendor portal record is created, we’ll issue PO (expected within 3 business days after docs are complete).

If LumenLine is able to offer a modest early-pay discount at Net15 or Net30, send the exact percentage and duration and we’ll evaluate. For many vendors we can pilot a 60–90 day early-pay program for the onboarding period.

I attached a short checklist to speed review: VendorOnboardChecklist.docx

Would 10:00am PT Monday work for a quick sync?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Vendor Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Katie Ramirez <katie@lumenline.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@lumenline.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment ramp & early-remit options

Thanks Lauren — Monday at 10:00am PT works.

A few clarifications on the early-pay schedule so Aditya and Monica can evaluate: we can do a pilot for the first 90 days with the following firm terms if Redwood chooses to accelerate remittance:
- Net45 standard with an offer: pay within 15 days (Net15) for 1.0% discount (pilot period only)
- Or Net30 with 0.5% discount for payment within 10 days (we can provide an invoice discount code to track this)

We’re fine splitting invoices (Setup = one invoice, Recurring = monthly usage). Attached is an updated early-pay schedule and a completed onboarding form; W9 is confirmed in the first packet.

Attachments: LL_earlypay_schedule.pdf

Looking forward to the sync.

—Katie
From: aditya.rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Katie Ramirez <katie@lumenline.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment ramp & early-remit options

Katie — appreciate the options and the paperwork. After quick review with Legal and AP we can approve the following pilot terms:

- Pilot period: first 90 days after first invoice receipt
- Payment terms during pilot: Net45 standard
- Early-pay option during pilot: Net15 for 1.0% discount (LumenLine's Net15 tier)
- After pilot: migrate to Net30 standard unless we mutually agree to keep Net45 for the contracted term

Next steps (owner in parentheses):
1) Katie / LumenLine: confirm final W9 and ACH form via DocuSign link (we will send a secure request) (Owner: LumenLine)
2) Monica: create vendor record and send portal invite (Owner: monica_patel)
3) Procurement: issue initial PO once vendor record is live — PO ID: PO-RED-2026-4897 (Owner: aditya_rao)
4) Lauren: coordinate kickoff and invoice split (setup vs monthly) (Owner: lauren_bishop)

We will send the DocuSign request for banking details within the hour. Once the portal invite goes out you should be able to accept terms and upload certificates.

If that all looks good I’ll start the PO flow.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
